Dear [Mr Innes](/person/744)
Thanks for the [cheque](/topic/160). I think it is a very good thing to cheapen [Womankind](/book/115), especially as it is getting a start through the [Mothers’ Union](/organisation/31) taking it up.

It will also be well to have [New Ground](/book/68) at 2s [Mr Scarth](/person/1272) of the Waterside Mission is very anxious to have Friday’s Child published separately for the sake of the sailors. I believe [Miss Crompton](/person/390)[^2] has been urged to write to you about it and I hope you will do it.

She is singularly unambitious

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^2]: Frances Crompton, author of Friday\'s Child, was one of Innes\'s authors.
